ubhayāpekkhādhippāya: [Ubhayāpekkhā+adhippāya] (pu) CL=7 Desires on consideration for two elements or causes or matters.
ubhayāppajahana: [Ubhaya+apa(ppa)jahana] (na) CL=7 Not rejecting the two causes or matters.
ubhayārammaṇa: [Ubhaya+ārammaṇa] (ti) CL=7 Attention on two matters or elements or causes, Concentrates on two elements or status.
ubhāyatobhāga: [Ubhāyato+bhāga] (pu) CL=7 For two matters or things or elements.
ubbandhitu: [U+bandha+tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To tie the neck with the rope, To commit suicide by hanging. See - Ubbandhitukāma.
ubbaṭṭanaghasanadhovana: [Ubbaṭṭana+ghaṃsana+dhovana] (na) CL=7 Rubbing and scrubbing the dirt, Washing.
ubbaṭṭeyyu: [U+vaṭṭa+ṇe+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should be scrubbed the dirt in particular. See - Ubbaṭṭeti.
ubbijjisu: [U+vijī+ya+uṃ] (kri) CL=7 They are frightening. See - Ubbijjati.
ubhayasa: [Ubhaya+aṃsa] (pu) CL=7 It is practiced for both aspects or objects. See also - Ubhayaṃsabhāvita.
ubhayasabhāvita: [Ubhayaṃsa+bhāvita] (ti) CL=7 (Samādhi) which should be meditated (nurtured ) for two matters or elements.
